sessions.weather_text: Looks dry but might have some damp spots, rained overnight; rained partway through
sessions.notes: A little understeery on entry in dry, but decent in damp; would be too sketchy in full wet. Front left is underdamped, way more time in rebound. Front right is slightly underdamped. Rear looks good.

sessions.weather_text: Damp; lots of rain partway through
setup_changes: Added air mid-session to correct balance
sessions.notes: Felt good, lots of rain partway through, but decent balance. Rear wanted to step out on puddles. Stopped halfway through to add air, balance came back.

sessions.weather_text: Damp, dried as the session went on
sessions.notes: Dried as the session went on. Tires over-pressured out of the window after a few laps. Lots of understeer mid corner — probably stiffen rear one step (2/3) to fix. Turn-in was good; exits were slightly understeering, but hard to tell if that was mid-corner understeer continuing.
